description: Tenant- and user-scoped Local Manager device-link lifecycle projection for pairing, linked-device readiness, revocation status, and expiry readback.
notes: Read-only activation projection. Pairing codes, code hashes, poll-token hashes, device-token identifiers, metadata_json, and all credential-bearing fields are excluded. This surface grants no pairing approval, token issuance, revocation, schema, provider, or database mutation authority.
